description: Compute percent of time within a simplified comfort box (temperature_c in [22, 26] and humidity_percent in [30, 60]); report compliance %, compliant minutes, and longest continuous non-compliance streak.

result_summary.name: compliance_percent
result_summary.description: Percent of time within comfort box [22-26]°C and [30-60]% RH (time-weighted).

result_summary.name: compliant_minutes
result_summary.description: Total minutes meeting both temperature and humidity comfort thresholds.

result_summary.name: longest_non_compliance_streak_minutes
result_summary.description: Longest continuous duration of non-compliance (sum of consecutive non-compliant intervals).
